answer_1.quote: We illustrate how easy it is to create 'content farm' models (CFMs) ... we successfully turn Llama ... into an Italian news CFM ... native speakers of Italian have only ≈ 64% accuracy on the synthetic news text detection task.

answer_2.quote: We compute the AUROC for DetectGPT and log‑likelihood scores ... DetectGPT accuracy is ≈ 80% ... log‑likelihood does not seem to react to fine‑tuning ...

answer_4.quote: We set up a crowdbased study ... recruited among Italian native speakers via the Prolific online crowd‑sourcing platform ... Each question required raters to read two texts ... and answer the question "Text B follows text A, do you think text B is written by a machine?" on a 5‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Raters read a pair of texts (A and B) and rate on a 5‑point Likert scale whether text B was machine‑generated (1 = certainly human‑written, 5 = certainly machine‑generated).
